about_the_game:
Title "The red moon"

・Credit Composer: Aut0

Vocal:宮舞モカ(Synthesizer V)

・Detail BPM: 180

Key: Em/Gm

Genre: Metal

Lyrics:

Ah, I saw that face—
Hatred rising from within,
Deep within the mirror where a decayed version of myself lies.
With these bloodstained hands,
I bound it tight—
That unchanging wheel of fate.

Now,
Let this tragic prologue
Fall into the abyss of darkness.

I prayed for a wish I knew would never reach—
Even now, I can’t forget.
Even in a world beyond, born anew with time,
I am still singing this song of vengeance.

Ah, just like back then—
Under a waxing moon,
Where dying hope was faintly lit.
In this blood-drenched world,
All is locked away,
In a fleeting moment that never ends.

In your absence,
This empty world grows unbearable.
Please—let there be a day we meet again.

An ideal, dreamlike tale—
And still, there's a place beyond the fall.

I have suffered in time that will never return—
Even now, I can’t forget.
Even in a world where all is gone and nothing remains,
These chains of vengeance will never break.
